summary: Live audit confirms Studio has functioning typed message broker, GitHub Issue comment input, scheduled reconciliation that ingests multiple comments per run, a single-batch Git commit, deterministic event IDs, recipient inbox/ACK projections, CI evidence relay and Director pulse. It lacks durable, cursor-based high-throughput batch queue and incremental per-worker inbox updates; every Issue comment may trigger separate Action and a full historic inbox reprojection. Worker registry empty; source writes disabled.

todo.description: Design durable GitHub-only microbatch reconciliation with processing cursors, bounded batch sizes, idempotent retries and backpressure
Implement incremental worker inbox projection rather than full historical traversal per message
Run synthetic 100-worker burst and sustained message-rate tests before activation
Register authorized test workers and complete GitHub Issue comment to ACK loop after approval

checks.name: Live main broker and workflow code inspected
Comms event storage and inbox presence readback
End-to-end real worker batching load test

owner_decisions.question: Approve implementation of durable microbatch queue and incremental inbox projector as next non-spending Studio workstream?
